subject: Request: one-off rebate for AtlasHealth due to delayed multi-model support
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off rebate for AtlasHealth due to delayed multi-model support

Aditya —

Quick summary: AtlasHealth (ATL-2026-092) is asking for a financial concession after we confirmed multi-model orchestration would be GA by end of Q2. Engineering has pushed the GA out ~6–8 weeks due to an unexpected compatibility regression across our prefetched KV cache. The customer is signaling procurement pressure this week and has paused the final PO.

They are a strategic U.S. health customer (risk to revenue ~$120k ARR in year one). I’m proposing a one-off rebate (not discount off list) of $45,000 applied as a credit over the first three monthly invoices to keep the deal moving while we deliver the feature. I’ve attached a short MRP impact sheet and an exec summary.

Ask: can Product confirm the timeline and approve the proposed concession as an exception? Finance (Laura) + Billing (Marcus) — please confirm whether we can structure as a credit and any contract language we should include. Vivek — flagging for your OK-to-approve at the sales leadership level; if you want this escalated for an exec signature I’ll draft the note.

Relevant links/attachments: HubSpot deal and MRP spreadsheet attached.

Thanks,
Naomi
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MRP_impact_spreadsheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off rebate for AtlasHealth due to delayed multi-model support

Naomi —

Thanks for the context and the MRP attachment. Short answer: the regression is real and the engineering ETA is 6 weeks for a safe GA (we're backporting a kernel fix and testing quantization interaction). I don’t think we can accelerate to less than 4 weeks without risk to stability.

Options we discussed with the team:
- Deliver a limited early-access build (feature-flagged) in ~3 weeks for Atlas to validate integration; this would be gated and not for general availability.
- Formal GA in ~6 weeks with full QA and performance validation.

Product position: we can support a short-term mitigation (early-access) plus prioritized support to reduce customer pain. I don’t have authority over commercial concessions — that needs sales + finance sign-off.

If Sales wants the rebate, please capture the business justification in a one-page exec summary (impact to ARR, renewal risk, strategic rationale). I’ll include a short note on the technical ETA that you can paste into that doc.

—Aditya
Sr. Product Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off rebate for AtlasHealth due to delayed multi-model support

Team —

I reviewed the deal and Naomi’s ask. I’m supportive in principle of a short-term rebate to preserve the relationship and close the PO, provided:
1) Finance confirms we can structure this as a time-bound credit (Laura/Marcus),
2) Sales owns a rollback clause if Atlas delays renewal beyond year one, and
3) We document the technical ETA from Product in the contract appendix.

Alternative I’d consider: offer a 3-month pilot of Dedicated capacity (discounted) as an operational mitigation rather than a straight cash rebate — that could reduce our revenue impact and accelerate adoption of our Dedicated offering. Naomi, if you can draft a 1-paragraph exec summary and the proposed credit schedule I’ll sign off at the sales leadership level and route to Exec for final approval if required.

Vivek
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@atlashealth.com>, Carlos Diaz <carlos.diaz@procure-atlas.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off rebate for AtlasHealth due to delayed multi-model support

Vivek/Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a 1-page exec summary and the proposed credit schedule. Key points:
- Proposed concession: $45,000 rebate applied as a credit over first 3 invoices (15k/mo).
- Justification: risk of losing a $120k ARR strategic health account; procurement pause until a signed PO is received.
- Mitigations: Product will provide an early-access build in ~3 weeks and GA in ~6 weeks (see Aditya note).
- Alternate option offered to customer: 3-month Dedicated pilot at 30% off list (customer prefers cash rebate).

Finance/Billing (Laura/Marcus) — can you confirm we can:
1) Apply the rebate as a contra credit on the invoice schedule?
2) Insert a limited-term credit clause in the SOW (language suggestion attached)?

If yes, Vivek — please confirm and I’ll prepare a short exec escalation package for sign-off (one slide + legal clause). If anyone prefers Exec sign-off instead of you signing, say so and I’ll route.

Sara/Carlos — we’re committed to delivering as promised and will keep you updated on the early-access deliverable once Aditya confirms the build readiness. Appreciate your patience.

Thanks,
Naomi
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Exec_Summary_Atlas_rebate.pdf (application/pdf)]
